prey.definition:
n. a person who is the aim of an attack (especially a victim of ridicule or exploitation) by some hostile person or influence
n. animal hunted or caught for food
v. profit from in an exploitatory manner
prey.translation:
n. 被掠食者, 牺牲者
vi. 捕食

preyed.translation: v. 掠食( prey的过去式和过去分词 ); 掠食; 折磨; （人）靠欺诈为生

preyer.definition:
n. One who, or that which, preys; a plunderer; a waster; a
   devourer.

preyer's reflex.translation: [医] 普赖厄氏反射(听觉耳动反射)

preyer's test.translation: [医] 普赖厄氏试验(检血一氧化碳)

preyer's tests.translation: [医] 普赖厄氏试验(检血一氧化碳)

preying.definition:
v profit from in an exploitatory manner
v prey on or hunt for

preys.definition:
n a person who is the aim of an attack (especially a victim of ridicule or exploitation) by some hostile person or influence
n animal hunted or caught for food
v profit from in an exploitatory manner
v prey on or hunt for
preys.translation: v. 掠食( prey的第三人称单数 ); 掠食; 折磨; （人）靠欺诈为生
